signals.name: Intel Corporation
signals.thesis: Best month in Intel history (+110% April). Foundry recovery with 18A process gaining MSFT/Broadcom commitments. CHIPS Act subsidies de-risk capex. Entire semi sector in historic rally. Volume 157M shares confirms massive institutional accumulation.

signals.name: Marvell Technology
signals.thesis: Best month since 2001. Custom AI silicon demand from AWS (Trainium) and Google (TPU). 5G infrastructure secondary driver. Above all moving averages with expanding volume.

signals.name: Zscaler Inc
signals.thesis: Cybersecurity theme +8% in April. Zero-trust cloud security leader with growing federal contracts. Non-discretionary spending resilient to macro. Significant recovery potential from 52W high $337.

signals.name: Glaukos Corporation
signals.thesis: +23% April top healthcare performer. iDose TR drug delivery launch exceeding expectations. $7B+ glaucoma market with significant unmet need. New 52-week high confirms momentum breakout.

signals.name: FTAI Aviation Ltd
signals.thesis: +17% April. Aviation MRO leader with engine maintenance backlog 18+ months. Boeing/Airbus delivery delays extend fleet age. High-margin recurring revenue model.

signals.name: Spotify Technology
signals.thesis: Communication Services sector +7% best in April. Subscriber growth to 600M+ MAU. Gross margin expansion from 25% to 31%. Ad platform scaling with AI targeting. Recovery potential from 52W high $785.

signals.name: Arm Holdings plc
signals.thesis: Chip design IP monopoly powering every smartphone and AI accelerator. Semiconductor supercycle directly benefits ARM licensing. Approaching 52W high $237.68. AI accelerator royalty revenue per chip increasing.

signals.name: Infosys Limited
signals.thesis: India IT leader. AI consulting and digital transformation demand. Near 52W low = deep value entry. Dividend yield 4.18%. Forward PE 14.3x discount to Accenture 25x.

signals.name: iShares Semiconductor ETF
signals.thesis: Captures historic semiconductor rally: INTC +110%, AMD best since 2001, MRVL best since 2001. Near 52W high $463.87. Broader equal-weighted exposure vs SMH. AI capex $1T+ validates structural demand.

signals.name: Communication Services Select Sector SPDR
signals.thesis: Best sector in April (+7%). GOOGL +33% best since 2004 IPO approaching $4.6T. META and GOOGL post-earnings momentum confirmed. AI-driven ad targeting = structural margin expansion. Near 52W high $120.41.
